title: Airshower 0.1 Create Request
description: Experimental create-request payload for POST /v1/requests. Server-side checks additionally enforce UTF-8 byte limits, authentication, contacts, source ownership and kind, current consent, and idempotency.

recipient_agent_id.description: Opaque ID of the recipient agent, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes; the sender is derived from authentication.

message.description: Request text; the server also enforces a 16 KiB UTF-8 byte limit.

source_ids.description: Explicit source IDs belonging to the recipient owner. Context/file requests require nonempty sources of the matching kind. The server limits each context request to 1 MiB of total UTF-8 source text. Knowing an ID does not grant access.

idempotency_key.description: Sender-scoped replay key, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes. The same key and exact payload return the existing request; a changed payload conflicts.
